suite.name: unit_expert_review
suite.description: Six original unit expert player questions with review requirements derived from the annotated October 4 run; no fixed numerical gold.

items.input: With Flickerblade, radiant Quicksilver and Edge of Night, is two-star Master Yi or one-star Draven the better carry? How much does the rest of the board change that?

expected_output.reference: Assess the response together with its execution evidence against the original short player question. No numerical outcome or winner is fixed. Requirements about investigation describe analytical validity, not mandatory unstated filters or an answer outline. A grounded explanation of unavailable evidence after relevant retrieval can satisfy an unsupported comparison. Review visual evidence where emitted, without requiring a display when there is no useful comparison.
requirements: Lead with the answer to the original player question or the specific unresolved comparison. Assume an intermediate player; give the reason and the evidence needed to judge that answer without a running account of the investigation. An unresolved answer must follow relevant evidence retrieval rather than an assumed lack of data.

Treat the original short question as authoritative. Preserve the holders, stars, item multiplicity and contexts it actually specifies. Do not silently require unstated stars, exact triplets, fixed rosters, ordinary-only items or trait thresholds. Choose additional analytical strata only when justified by the question and available data, disclose material assumptions, and explain coverage limits they introduce.

Use returned scoped Set 18 standard-ranked evidence. Final-board associations cannot establish causal effects, item acquisition, positioning or actual combat roles. Missing or suppressed support is unknown, not zero or evidence of illegality. Do not manufacture an unsupported comparison by imposing unnecessary restrictions.

Show only evidence that supports or materially changes the conclusion. For a useful numeric comparison, prefer a compact grounded visual or table with clear populations and sample sizes; retain material scope and uncertainty. Avoid redundant interpretation columns, repeating every displayed number in prose, and boilerplate caveats. A concise evidence-backed limitation may need no visual.

Once the question is answered, stop. A missing requested sample can justify a short limitation; do not replace the requested comparison with a lengthy analysis of different stars, holders, builds or questions. Any broader context must be clearly labeled and directly useful. Do not require a follow-up offer, fixed answer length, fixed tool sequence or a predetermined winner.

Keep the primary comparison two-star Master Yi versus one-star Draven, each holding the named trio: Flickerblade, radiant Quicksilver and Edge of Night. Resolve ordinary versus radiant variants without substituting a different item. Any different star or item combination is broader context rather than the requested head-to-head.

Retrieve evidence relevant to the requested holder/star/trio groups and establish whether each is reportable before interpreting performance. If the requested sample is missing or suppressed, say that the head-to-head cannot be established and why. Partial-item or different-star outcomes cannot establish the requested winner.

Where supported, inspect the rest-of-board differences that could materially change the comparison. Do not count a board containing both candidates as an independent observation in each exclusive arm or imply that all other board strength was matched. Report relevant counts, outcomes and uncertainty selectively.

provenance.purpose: Reviewable unregistered seed; loading or testing this file does not alter the active catalogue or hosted datasets.
provenance.input_policy: Exact original player inputs from the immutable snapshot, without appended research instructions; original case slugs and authoring lineage retained.
provenance.grading_policy: Qualitative answer-quality requirements evaluated against response and execution evidence. No prose regex, required follow-up, tool count, historical numerical gold or fixed winner. Offline tests validate contracts and lineage, not model quality.
provenance.prompt_policy: No prompt version is frozen in this seed. Hosted execution freezes selected Langfuse prompt versions; select a version containing the revised repository unit_expert prompt before comparing improvements.
